newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran quake toll climbs to 965 - official.
newsitem.headline: Iran quake toll climbs to 965 - official.

text.p: Some 965 people were confirmed dead on Monday from an earthquake which struck northwestern Iran on Friday.
The official Iranian news agency IRNA, in a despatch from Ardabil, capital of the quake-stricken province, said some 36,000 people had sustained losses in 82 villages.
The Interior Ministry's natural disasters headquarters reported 965 confirmed dead and more than 2,600 injured, IRNA reported.
Friday's quake registered 5.5 on the Richter scale, it said.
The quake was followed by more than 350 aftershocks in heavy snow and sub-freezing conditions.
A second quake on Sunday measuring 5.2 on the Richter scale jolted the rugged region prompting rescue teams to comb the area for new damage and casualties.
